creative_improvements.idea: Regime-adaptive ATR_SL — widen SL by 0.2% in EXTREME regime
creative_improvements.rationale: EXTREME 48.7%WR +.49/7d (best regime) but 67% of exits are atr_sl_hit. EXTREME = high volatility = wider swings. Current ATR_SL 1.3-1.5% gets hit by noise. Wider SL (1.5-1.7%) lets EXTREME trades breathe. 14d: EXTREME atr_sl_hit = 66T 43%WR -/usr/bin/bash.66. If 20% fewer hits → +/usr/bin/bash.13/7d. Conservative estimate.
creative_improvements.risk: low — only affects EXTREME regime, only widens SL by 0.2%

creative_improvements.idea: REGIME_CONF_MULTIPLIER — boost confidence 1.15x in EXTREME, penalize 0.85x in NORMAL
creative_improvements.rationale: EXTREME 48.7%WR +.49 vs NORMAL 29.4%WR -.52. Gap .01/7d. Currently no regime adjustment to confidence. Higher confidence in EXTREME = more trades from best regime. Lower in NORMAL = fewer trades from worst.
